collections.habit: Renovation shopping is filed by room. Berlin-specific travel is separate from unplanned trip ideas. School administration and health are separate from recipes and books.

Books and ebooks to read or buy, including travel, food and parenting books.
Recipes and practical meal plans to cook at home, including family lunchbox meals.

collections.habit: Client identity takes priority over design topic. Generic references are separate. Tax administration is filed by jurisdiction, not by the page language. Camera shopping and photo locations are separate.
